test_cases.test_case: Very long Username string submission
preconditions: Login page is displayed
A valid teacher account exists for which the correct Password is available
steps: 1. Enter <very long string> in the Username field (string length significantly greater than typical UI display, e.g., 200+ characters)
2. Enter the valid account Password in the Password field
3. Click the "Log in" button
test_cases.expected_result: Either: (A) The system accepts the long Username and login succeeds; user is redirected to the Dashboard. Or: (B) The Username input is truncated or rejected and the login is blocked with an inline error message (error visible next to the form); if rejected, Password field is cleared and the (possibly truncated) Username remains visible for correction.

test_cases.test_case: Unicode and emoji characters in Username and Password

steps: 1. Enter <username containing Unicode characters and emoji> in the Username field
2. Enter <password containing Unicode characters and emoji> in the Password field
3. Click the "Log in" button
test_cases.expected_result: Either: (A) The system accepts Unicode/emoji in credentials and login succeeds; user is redirected to the Dashboard. Or: (B) The system rejects those characters and the login is blocked with an inline error message; Password field is cleared and the Username remains populated for correction.

test_cases.test_case: Leading and trailing whitespace in Username is preserved or trimmed
preconditions: Login page is displayed
A valid teacher account exists whose canonical Username is known
steps: 1. Enter <Username with leading and trailing whitespace around the canonical Username> in the Username field
2. Enter the valid account Password in the Password field
3. Click the "Log in" button
test_cases.expected_result: If the UI trims whitespace: leading/trailing whitespace is removed and login succeeds when underlying credentials match the trimmed Username; user is redirected to the Dashboard and any displayed Username (e.g., header) contains no extra spaces. If the UI does not trim: the login will likely be blocked with an inline error and the Password field cleared while the Username (including whitespace) remains visible for correction.

test_cases.test_case: Rapid back-button after successful login then immediate resubmit
preconditions: Login page is displayed
A valid teacher account exists
steps: 1. Enter the valid Username in the Username field
2. Enter the valid Password in the Password field
3. Click the "Log in" button
4. Wait for redirect to the Dashboard
5. Click the browser Back button to return to the Login page
6. Without changing any fields, click the "Log in" button again
test_cases.expected_result: Either: (A) After returning via Back the Login form is shown blank (no pre-filled Username/Password), so clicking Log in without entering credentials is blocked and an inline error is shown. Or: (B) If fields are preserved by the browser, clicking Log in does not create duplicate side-effects; the user is redirected to the Dashboard without creating a second distinct session artifact. In all cases, no visible duplicate account/session creation should occur and any inline error messages appear next to the form if submission is invalid.

test_cases.test_case: After logout, access to a protected page without re-authentication is blocked

test_cases.test_case: Rapid double-click of Log out button
preconditions: User must be logged in
User is on a protected page where the Log out button is visible
steps: 1. Click the "Log out" button
2. Immediately click the "Log out" button again (within a fraction of a second)
test_cases.expected_result: First click succeeds: session is terminated and the browser redirects to the login page with the login form visible. The immediate second click is blocked/ignored (no additional redirect or duplicate action) and no error is shown; protected pages require re-authentication.

test_cases.test_case: Use browser Back after logout to access previous protected page
preconditions: User must be logged in

2. Click the browser Back button once
test_cases.expected_result: Attempt to navigate back to the protected page is blocked; the login page (login form) is displayed instead or an explicit session-expired message is shown. Protected content is not accessible without re-authentication (the navigation is blocked / error shown).

test_cases.test_case: Logout in one tab, then perform action in another tab with cached authenticated view

steps: 1. In Tab A, click the "Log out" button
2. In Tab B, click a link to a protected page or refresh the protected page
test_cases.expected_result: Attempt to access or refresh protected content in Tab B is blocked; Tab B is redirected to the login page and protected content is not shown. The protected action is blocked / error shown and re-authentication is required.

test_cases.test_case: Navigate directly to a bookmarked/protected URL after logout
preconditions: User must be logged in and has a bookmarked or known URL of a protected page
steps: 1. Click the "Log out" button

test_cases.expected_result: Direct navigation to the protected URL is blocked; the browser displays the login page (login form) and the protected resource is not accessible without re-authentication (navigation is blocked / error shown).
